boundary_note: Bounded first pass for the ten frozen records without dossiers in Grant's Operations Against Vicksburg [March-July 1863]; the existing MS009 draft is unchanged. Preserve per-engagement dates. MS011's frozen siege interval (May 18–July 4) contains the separate Milliken's Bend (June 7), Goodrich's Landing (June 29–30) and Helena (July 4) engagements; campaign-wide loss figures must not be assigned to any one engagement. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. The frozen side-specific numerical strength bounds are blank (missing_numeric_strength). No figure in this pass is adopted as a simultaneous opening force.

claims.value: The frozen force field names the Mississippi Squadron with seven companies of the 58th Ohio, and Bowen's Division, without counts; the live field reads zero. NPS says Porter led seven ironclads; Greene lists his squadron at 81 guns against batteries containing only thirteen guns, and gives Bowen's force, including Green's brigade, as about 4,700 men on April 28. Bowen reported six gunboats averaging ten guns.
claims.rationale: Naval armament, battery armament and a pre-engagement garrison figure differ in scope and source; none is adopted as matched opening strength. Live zeros are not measured absence.

claims.value: The frozen and live results read Confederate victory. NPS calls it a hollow victory. Greene says the guns were silenced by 1 p.m. but the batteries remained as capable of resisting assault, their guns resuming fire later; Bowen reports the gunboats retired after six hours and a half.
claims.rationale: Retain the original result and engagement interval; later movements and campaign contribution are different measures. No new probabilities or individual causal credit. NPS's 'hollow victory' is campaign context.

claims.value: The frozen casualty text reads Total unknown (US 80; CS unknown); the live field reads 80 total (US 80; CS 0;). Greene gives the Confederate troops 3 killed and 15 wounded and Porter 19 killed and 56 wounded; Bowen reported 3 killed and 12 or 15 wounded.
claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap. Porter's 19 and 56 sum to 75 (a computation here), not the frozen 80; the live Confederate zero is not measured absence.

open_questions: Porter's and the navy's reports, McClernand's report and the Grand Gulf battery returns remain deferred.

NPS/CWSAC is one family. Greene is one retrospective history by a non-participant, founded on the Official Records. Each report author selected from Official Records Volumes XXIV and XXII is a separate family of interested accounts; the volumes are shared containers, not additional witnesses, and letters or telegrams by others quoted inside a selected document are not separate families. Report dates are not event times or proof of contemporary knowledge.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
